title: One-step configuration transition
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols and state set $S$, and configurations $c,c'$ on the same input, define $c'$ to be a one-step successor of $c$ if there is a choice bit $b\in\{0,1\}$ for which the machine's transition using $b$ takes $c$ to $c'$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $S$
Two configurations on the same Boolean input
